title: ICAR-CPRI Potato Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) Management Advisory
content:
Crop: Potato (Solanum tuberosum)
Disease: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
Region: Punjab & Indo-Gangetic Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI), Shimla / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://cpri.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Identification & Symptoms:
• Water-soaked dark necrotic lesions on leaf margins and tips rapidly expanding during cloudy, foggy weather with >90% RH and temperatures 10-20°C.
• White cottony fungal growth on underside of leaves; purplish-brown sunken firm dry rot on infected tubers.

2. Immediate Cultural & Sanitation Precautions:
• High earthing-up (ridging) to provide a thick soil barrier preventing sporangia from washing down into developing tubers.
• Use certified disease-free seed tubers from disease-free seed production zones.
• Haulm cutting (dehaulming) 10-12 days before tuber harvesting to allow skin curing and prevent harvest contact infection.

3. Chemical Treatment (CIBRC / ICAR-CPRI Approved):
• Prophylactic Spray: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L before canopy closure or upon weather advisory warning.
• Curative Spray (Upon Disease Appearance): Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.0 g/L.
• Safe Usage & PHI: Pre-Harvest Interval is 15-20 days.
cultural_precautions: High earthing-up; certified disease-free seed; dehaulming 10 days before harvest.
sanitation_guidance: Destroy infected potato cull piles and volunteer plants.
moisture_irrigation_guidance: Avoid furrow water stagnation; irrigate in early daylight hours.
non_chemical_management: Plant late-blight resistant varieties such as Kufri Girdhari or Kufri Himalini where recommended.
chemical_treatment: Prophylactic: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L. Curative: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Mancozeb 75% WP and Metalaxyl + Mancozeb registered under Insecticides Act for potato late blight.
phi_safety_limitations: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 15-20 days; use personal protective equipment.
content_hi:
आलू पछेती झुलसा (Late Blight - Phytophthora infestans):
लक्षण: पत्तियों के किनारों पर काले-भूरे जलसिक्त धब्बे, निचली सतह पर सफेद रुई जैसी फफूंद।
सांस्कृतिक उपाय: आलू के थालों पर अच्छी मिट्टी चढ़ाएं (Earthing-up) ताकि कंद सुरक्षित रहें।
रासायनिक उपचार: रोग के पूर्व लक्षण पर मैंकोजेब 75% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.5 ग्राम/लीटर पानी; रोग प्रकट होने पर मेटालेक्सिल + मैंकोजेब @ 2.5 ग्राम/लीटर पानी। PHI: 15-20 दिन।

title: ICAR-CPRI Potato Early Blight (Alternaria solani) Advisory
content:
Crop: Potato (Solanum tuberosum)
Disease: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
Region: Punjab & Northern Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://cpri.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Symptoms & Management:
• Dark brown angular spots with target-board concentric rings, typically on lower older leaves.
• Chemical Treatment (CIBRC Approved): Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Propineb 70% WP @ 2.0 g/L at first disease detection. PHI: 14 days.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Propineb 70% WP @ 2.0 g/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Mancozeb registered for potato early blight.
content_hi:
आलू अगेती झुलसा (Early Blight - Alternaria solani):
उपचार: मैंकोजेब 75% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.0 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें। PHI: 14 दिन।

title: ICAR-CPRI Potato Healthy Crop Maintenance Advisory
content:
Crop: Potato (Solanum tuberosum)
Disease: Healthy Crop & Tuber Quality Maintenance
Region: Punjab & Northern Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-CPRI Shimla
Official Bulletin: https://cpri.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

• Timely earthing up, balanced potash application for tuber firming, aphid scouting, clean dehaulming.
content_hi: आलू स्वस्थ फसल प्रबंधन: समय पर मिट्टी चढ़ाएं और पोटाश का समुचित प्रयोग करें।
